method: Pointwise median of preceding completed cycle curves
phase_convention: For each complete cycle, first observed month maps to phase 0 and last month before the next minimum maps to phase 1; linear interpolation to 121 equally spaced phase points.
cycle_boundary_convention: Published minimum inclusive, next published minimum exclusive. Cycle 25 minimum is used only as Cycle 24's end boundary.
curve_metric_interpretation: Phase-aligned curve errors condition on each held-out cycle's observed duration; duration prediction is evaluated separately.
peak_metric_definition: Raw monthly SSN maximum of the phase-grid curve; timing is normalized peak phase multiplied by duration minus one.
interval_definition: Pointwise empirical 10th and 90th percentiles across training curves. Coverage is pointwise across phase grid, not cycle-level simultaneous coverage.
training_rule: Held-out cycle c uses only completed cycles 1..c-1.
limitations: Curve metrics use retrospective phase alignment and do not by themselves validate calendar-time forecasting.
Pointwise intervals are not guaranteed to be calibrated.
Cycle 26 and 27 curves are exploratory analog forecasts, not validated predictions.
Raw monthly peaks are not the same as the published smoothed peak labels used in Task 2.
